entries.title: II Chronicles 16:1
segments: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, so that he might let no one go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:2
segments: And Asa brought out silver and gold from the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house and sent them to Ben-hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:3
segments: A treaty between you and me, as [there was] between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he may depart from me.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:4
segments: And Ben-hadad listened to king Asa, and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel. And they struck Ijon and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:5
segments: And it happened when Baasha heard, he left off building Ramah, and let his work stop.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:6
segments: And Asa the king took all Judah. And they carried away the stones of Ramah, and timber with which Baasha was building. And he built with it Geba and Mizpah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:7
segments: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on the LORD your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:8
segments: Were not the Cushites and the Libyans a huge army with many chariots and horsemen? Yet, because you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your hand.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:9
segments: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro in all the whole earth to show Himself strong on behalf of those whose heart [is] perfect toward Him. You have done foolishly in this; therefore from now on you shall have wars.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:10
segments: And Asa was angry with the seer and put him in a prison-house. For [he was] in a rage with him because of this. And Asa oppressed some of the people at that time.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:11
segments: And behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they [are] written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:12
segments: And in the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa [was] diseased in his feet, until his disease [was] very grievous. Yet in his disease he did not seek to the LORD, but to the physicians.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:13
segments: And Asa slept with his fathers and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

entries.title: II Chronicles 16:14
segments: And they buried him in his own tomb, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and kinds [of spices] prepared by the perfumers art. And they made a very great burning for him.
